name: National Defence Academy and Naval Academy Examination
department: Ministry of Defence (Army, Navy, Air Force)
summary: The Class 12 route to becoming an officer in the Army, Navy or Air Force. Held twice a year and open to unmarried men and women. Selected cadets train for 3 years at the National Defence Academy, Pune (with a degree), or 4 years at the Indian Naval Academy, then are commissioned as officers on a Permanent Commission.
frequency: Twice a year (NDA I and NDA II, official UPSC calendar)

status.note: Two cycles every year. NDA I: notification in December, exam in April. NDA II: notification in May, exam in September. Courses start in January and July.

cycles.cycle: NDA & NA (II) 2026 (158th NDA / 120th INAC, from 1 Jul 2027)

posts.name: NDA Army wing
posts.responsibilities: 3 years at NDA, then about 1 year at IMA; commissioned as Lieutenant.

posts.name: NDA Navy wing (Executive branch)
posts.responsibilities: 3 years at NDA, then naval training; commissioned as Sub Lieutenant.

posts.name: NDA Air Force wing: Flying
posts.responsibilities: Pilot officer after NDA and Air Force Academy training.

posts.name: NDA Air Force wing: Ground Duties (Technical)
NDA Air Force wing: Ground Duties (Non-Technical)
Indian Naval Academy (10+2 Cadet Entry Scheme, Executive branch)
posts.responsibilities: 4 years at INA Ezhimala with a B.Tech; commissioned as Sub Lieutenant.

age.summary: Unmarried men and women aged about 16 and a half to 19 and a half at course start. For NDA & NA (II) 2026: born between 1 January 2008 and 1 January 2011, both dates included.

eligibility.nationality: Citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries, with a Government of India eligibility certificate (not needed for Gorkha subjects of Nepal).

education.summary: Army wing: Class 12 pass (any stream) under the 10+2 pattern. Air Force and Navy wings, and INA 10+2 Cadet Entry: Class 12 pass with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.

attempts.limit: No attempt limit (within the age window)

eligibility.physical: Service medical and physical standards, checked by a medical board after the SSB.
eligibility.medical: Service medical boards, with an appeal medical board.
other: Must be unmarried and stay unmarried during training.
Class 12 students can apply; proof must reach the Army or Naval HQ by the date in the notice if not shown at the SSB.
Fee as per notice; women, SC and ST candidates are exempt.
eligibility.examVsPost: Anyone in the age window with Class 12 can sit the exam, but only candidates with Physics, Chemistry and Maths in Class 12 can be placed in the Navy, Air Force or INA. Arts and commerce students can choose the Army wing only.
disqualifications: Candidates earlier removed from a service academy on disciplinary grounds are not considered.
eligibility.reservation: No caste or EWS reservation. Vacancies are notified separately for men and women.

eligibilityRules.notes: Exact eligibility is a date-of-birth window in each notice (NDA II 2026: born 1 Jan 2008 to 1 Jan 2011). Navy, Air Force and INA need Physics, Chemistry and Maths in Class 12. Must be unmarried.

stages.name: Written examination (objective)

papers.name: Mathematics
papers.negative: One third of the question's marks

papers.name: General Ability Test (Part A English 200, Part B General Knowledge 400)
papers.negative: One third of the question's marks

stages.notes: Written total 900. Maths and GAT Part B are bilingual (Hindi and English).

stages.name: SSB Intelligence and Personality Test
stages.notes: Stage I: OIR test and PP&DT. Stage II over 4 days: interview, group testing tasks, psychology tests and conference. Air Force (flying) candidates also take the Computerised Pilot Selection System.

selection.meritCalculation: Final merit = written (900) + SSB (900) = 1800. Minimum marks apply separately to the written exam and the SSB.
selection.tieBreaking: As stated in the notification (rounding to two decimals, then written marks and age).
selection.languages: English paper in English; Maths and GK in Hindi and English.
selection.probation: 3 years at NDA (2.5 years common to all three wings) with a JNU degree (B.Sc., B.Sc. Computer, B.A. or B.Tech), then pre-commissioning training at IMA, the Naval Academy or Air Force Academy. INA cadets train for 4 years with a B.Tech.

sections.subject: Mathematics (300 marks)
topics: Algebra: sets, relations, complex numbers, quadratic equations, binomial theorem, logarithms
Analytical geometry of two and three dimensions

sections.subject: GAT Part A: English (200 marks)
topics: Comprehension and cohesion in extended text

sections.subject: GAT Part B: General Knowledge (400 marks)

supplementary: The full topic list is in the notification appendix.
The Maths paper is at Class 11 and 12 level.

statistics.note: NDA & NA (II) 2022. Recommended can exceed vacancies because lists are drawn per service and course.

rankAndAllocation.text: Separate merit lists are made by service and gender. Candidates are placed by merit, their service preferences, PCM eligibility (for Navy and Air Force) and medical fitness. Air Force flying candidates must also clear the pilot aptitude test.

specialAllowances.name: During training
specialAllowances.detail: Cadets are under training for 3 to 4 years; officer pay starts on commissioning.

specialAllowances.name: Military Service Pay
specialAllowances.detail: Rs 15,500 a month for officers from Lieutenant to Brigadier.

salary.pension: Defence pension (armed forces are not under NPS).
salary.increments: 3% a year; time-scale promotions as for other Permanent Commission officers.
salary.notes: The salary estimate applies after commissioning.

progression.timeline: On commissioning (about 4 to 4.5 years after joining NDA)

career.promotionNotes: Time-scale promotions up to the Lt Col equivalent; selection boards above that. The time-scale years shown are those in the UPSC defence notices.
career.departmentalExams: Service promotion exams as per rules.

benefits.detail: Degree from Jawaharlal Nehru University on passing out.
As for all armed forces officers.

workLife.postings: Anywhere in India, at sea or at air bases, including border and field areas.
workLife.workload: Very demanding; long training and field tenures.

difficulty.rationale: Over 3 lakh appear for about 400 seats (NDA II 2022: 3,36,220 appeared for 400 vacancies, about 840 per vacancy). Class 11 and 12 Maths at speed, then a 5-day SSB and a strict medical.

ratings.rationale: Twice-yearly exam with a free degree and a full officer career, but postings are entirely decided by the service.

factors.note: About 3 years of eligibility, so only a few attempts are possible.
Most written qualifiers are not recommended at the SSB.

sections.title: What NDA is
paragraphs: NDA is the officer entry right after Class 12. You train for 3 years at the National Defence Academy in Pune, earning a JNU degree, then go to your service academy for final training. Women have been eligible since 2021 and vacancies are notified separately for them.

sections.title: The written exam
paragraphs: Mathematics (Class 11 and 12 level) and the General Ability Test. GAT has English (200 marks) and General Knowledge (400 marks) covering physics, chemistry, general science, history, geography and current events.

sections.title: SSB and final merit
paragraphs: The SSB is weighted equally with the written exam: 900 marks each. It has a screening day (intelligence test and picture discussion), then 4 days of interview, group tasks and psychology tests, ending with a conference.

sections.title: Common confusions
bullets: Without Physics, Chemistry and Maths in Class 12 you can only be placed in the Army wing.
The Indian Naval Academy 10+2 Cadet Entry is filled through the same exam but trains for 4 years at Ezhimala, not at NDA.
There is no caste reservation or age relaxation in NDA.
Your eligibility is a date-of-birth window, so it changes with every cycle.
